# Integration Harness

Reads an interface definition and generates an integration
test harness that wires conformance suites against a
containerised dependency. Bridges the conformance suite
generator with the `SharedContainer` and
`IntegrationHarness` primitives.

## go:generate directive

```go
// In the plugin's test file or generate.go:
//go:generate testkit integration -o integration_test.gen.go -suite RunStoreSuite -container postgres:17-alpine Store
```

## Default output

`integration_test.gen.go`

## What is generated

```go
// Code generated by testkit integration. DO NOT EDIT.

package postgres_test

import (
    "os"
    "testing"

    "go.thesmos.sh/testkit"
    "example.com/myapp/store"
    "example.com/myapp/store/storetest"
)

var sharedContainer *testkit.Container

func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
    sharedContainer = testkit.SharedContainer(m, testkit.ContainerConfig{
        Image:   "postgres:17-alpine",
        Port:    "5432/tcp",
        WaitFor: "database system is ready",
        Env:     map[string]string{"POSTGRES_PASSWORD": "test"},
    })
    os.Exit(m.Run())
}

func TestStore_Integration(t *testing.T) {
    dsn := sharedContainer.DSN(t)
    storetest.RunStoreSuite(t, storetest.StoreSpec{
        Factory: func() store.Store {
            return newTestStore(t, dsn)
        },
    })
}

func TestStore_IntegrationBench(b *testing.B) {
    dsn := sharedContainer.DSN(b)
    storetest.RunStoreBenchSuite(b, storetest.StoreSpec{
        Factory: func() store.Store {
            return newTestStore(b, dsn)
        },
    })
}
```

## Injection point

The developer writes a companion file with the factory
that knows how to create a real implementation from a DSN:

```go
// integration_helpers_test.go — hand-written

func newTestStore(t testing.TB, dsn string) store.Store {
    pool := connectPool(t, dsn)
    return postgres.NewStore(pool)
}
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `-suite` | Name of the conformance suite function to wire |
| `-container` | Container image (sets up `SharedContainer`) |
| `-port` | Container port mapping (default: auto-detect from image) |
| `-env` | Container env vars (repeatable: `-env K=V`) |

## Why

Every plugin that implements a core interface needs
the same wiring: `TestMain` with `SharedContainer`,
conformance suite invocation, bench suite invocation. This
is ~40 lines of identical structure per plugin per
interface. The integration generator eliminates this
boilerplate while keeping the domain-specific factory in
the developer's hands.

## Scale

~10 plugin x interface pairs x ~40 lines = ~400 lines.
